tools.name: goaudits_list_checklists
tools.description: List the audit checklists (templates) in your GoAudits account. Read only. POST /audits/getchecklists.

tools.name: goaudits_list_companies
tools.description: List the companies in your GoAudits account. Read only. POST /audits/getcompanieslist.

tools.name: goaudits_list_locations
tools.description: List the locations (sites) in your GoAudits account. Read only. POST /audits/getlocations.

tools.name: goaudits_list_users
tools.description: List the users (admins, managers and auditors) in your GoAudits account. Read only. POST /audits/userlist.

tools.name: goaudits_list_audit_summaries
tools.description: List one summary row per audit (score, status, location, auditor, dates) for a date range. Read only. POST /audits/getauditsummary.

tools.name: goaudits_get_audit
tools.description: Get the question-by-question details of one audit (answers, scores, comments). Read only. The date range must include the audit date. POST /audits/getauditdetailsbyid.

tools.name: goaudits_list_action_plans
tools.description: List the action plan items (corrective actions, owners, due dates) for a date range. Read only. POST /audits/getactionplanlist.

tools.name: goaudits_get_action_plan
tools.description: Get the action plan items of one audit by its audit id. Read only. POST /audits/getactionplandetails.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: goaudits_list_checklists, goaudits_list_companies, goaudits_list_locations, goaudits_list_users, goaudits_list_audit_summaries, goaudits_get_audit, goaudits_list_action_plans, goaudits_get_action_plan · Public sink: goaudits_list_checklists, goaudits_list_companies, goaudits_list_locations, goaudits_list_users, goaudits_list_audit_summaries, goaudits_get_audit, goaudits_list_action_plans, goaudits_get_action_plan.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: goaudits_list_checklists, goaudits_list_companies, goaudits_list_locations, goaudits_list_users, goaudits_list_audit_summaries, goaudits_get_audit, goaudits_list_action_plans, goaudits_get_action_plan · Public sink: goaudits_list_checklists, goaudits_list_companies, goaudits_list_locations, goaudits_list_users, goaudits_list_audit_summaries, goaudits_get_audit, goaudits_list_action_plans, goaudits_get_action_plan

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
